title: Working title
note: Any global note about how to read or use this outline — POV assignment logic, structural conventions, anything a writer needs before opening a chapter entry
premise: The concrete unstable situation copied verbatim from the synopsis
central_question: The dramatic question copied verbatim from the synopsis
reader_promise: The spoiler-light experience and satisfaction copied verbatim from the synopsis
story_answer: The spoiler-containing answer copied verbatim from the synopsis

chapters.title: Chapter title
chapters.what_must_happen: Directive prose telling the writer exactly what to write: who is in the scene, what occurs, what the reader must see and feel, how it ends. Present tense. Specific and imperative. This is a production instruction, not a description.
chapters.premise_movement: How this chapter changes the unstable situation, the protagonist's options, or the cost of pursuing the premise
chapters.question_pressure: How this chapter poses, complicates, reframes, narrows, or answers the central question through action and choice
chapters.promise_delivery: The concrete part of the reader experience or satisfaction delivered on the page in this chapter
trope_obligations: trope_id: setup | development | payoff | texture | subversion - concrete chapter action
chapters.ends_with: The exact state of play at the chapter's close — what each relevant character knows, has, and wants. What is unresolved. 1-2 sentences.
